title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: the value re-issued in the documented current generation (cflt + 54 + a 6-character CRC32 checksum, docs.confluent.io), a secret of the sibling confluent-cloud-api-secret family. This twin is scoped to the legacy family: the product reporting it as confluent-cloud-api-secret is co-detection, not a false alarm here; only a legacy-family finding fails it. Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
